title: Initech support review
transcript:
Marcus: Both escalations this quarter were the same bug — proxy timeouts on long tool calls. Vasquez wrote it up on the public tracker.
Lee: Keep-alive on the tool channel fixes it. It rides along with the Thursday release train, or the one after.
Marcus: Good. Their compliance team also keeps asking about transcript retention. Sam is writing the retention default into the docs.
Lee: Ninety days, yes. It'll be published this sprint.
Lee: Also, Vasquez flagged something new on Friday: mid-thread the assistant switches to Spanish and stays there for the rest of the conversation. Their team is German-speaking, so it is not a locale setting. He hasn't opened a ticket for it yet.
Marcus: Then someone should. Add it to the tracker.
Marcus: Last thing — 1042 is due the ninth under the net-sixty goodwill terms. Finance wants net-sixty gone at the September renewal, so brace for that conversation.
